summary.name: Message AI - GPT TTS
summary.one_liner: An iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS app for chatting with GPT-based AI assistants, generating images, and converting text to speech, with conversations synced over iCloud.
use_cases: Chatting with an AI assistant on iPhone, iPad or Mac
Using AI inside other apps via the keyboard extension
Running saved or custom prompts across devices
Automating AI tasks with Shortcuts and Siri
summary.what_it_does: The app provides an AI chat assistant where users can create multiple conversations that sync across iPhone, iPad and macOS through iCloud. It includes built-in and custom prompts, which also sync across devices, and supports searching conversation histories and prompts. A text-to-image feature uses a Stable Diffusion model, and a text-to-speech feature is available. A keyboard extension gives access to the AI from any app, and the app can be used in Shortcuts and Siri.
notable: Keyboard extension for using AI in any app
Conversations and prompts sync across devices via iCloud
Text to image via Stable Diffusion and text to speech
caveats: Core AI features are in-app purchases: GPT-3.5 cloud $1.99, Stable Diffusion cloud $0.99, Text to Speech $0.99
Requires iOS 16.0 or later, iPadOS 16.0, macOS 13.0 or visionOS 1.0
